evidence_items.title: Hebbia sees improvements in financial research with GPT-6 Astra
evidence_items.summary: Hebbia tested GPT-6 Astra for financial research. Its prerelease evaluations found gains in source coverage, citation relevance, and presentation quality.

evidence_items.title: Can AI help scientists identify promising drug candidates?
evidence_items.summary: MedChemBench evaluates how well AI models interpret molecular structures, reason from experimental evidence, and select compounds in early drug discovery.
